name: LifeMoves Opportunity Services Center
description: Drop-in center with free breakfast and lunch, showers, laundry, mailboxes, lockers, and case management for adults experiencing homelessness
fullDescription: The LifeMoves Opportunity Services Center (OSC) is a low-barrier drop-in center in Palo Alto serving mainly single adults experiencing homelessness, with meals, showers, laundry, and case management. LifeMoves also runs a Palo Alto outreach team out of OSC.
whatTheyOffer:
- Daily breakfast and lunch
- Showers and laundry
- Mailboxes and personal lockers
- Case management and resource navigation
- Connections to shelter and housing
- Palo Alto street outreach team
howToGetIt:
1. Drop in Monday-Friday, 8am-4pm (call to confirm hours)
2. No appointment needed
3. Use meals, showers, laundry, and other services
4. Ask staff about case management
5. For shelter in Santa Clara County, use the county's Coordinated Entry System or dial 2-1-1
keywords: LifeMoves, Opportunity Services Center, OSC, Palo Alto, drop-in center, homeless services, meals, showers, laundry, case management
